title: 1 Penny
description: The 1 penny coin is a small copper-plated steel coin used in the UK since 1971. It’s essential for low-value transactions.

messages.text: What is the 1 penny coin made of?
Was it always made of that material?
No, it used to be bronze.
Is the 1p coin still used widely?
No, that’s illegal in the UK.
Is there talk of removing it?
Yes, but no official plans yet.
